notes: This contract pins the bounded Auto Provide behavior in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. The composed FDD seeds one federation-wide dynamic value, omitted input is Disabled, the standard HLAsetSwitches MOM interaction can change that value during execution using the official HLAswitch encoding, and an enabled value causes the RTI to solicit current owners of newly discovered in-scope attributes through Provide Attribute Value Update with an empty tag. The public regional slices now cover callback-time DDM and switch revalidation, two-owner grouping, independent source-region projections, exact-touch Allow Relaxed DDM eligibility with positive-gap suppression, fresh post-reenable discovery, receive-order and timestamped switch mutation before provider-callback admission, and timestamped responses admitted before switch disable that are delivered once at their grants. Save/restore, package evidence, protected review, JUnit promotion, and conformance remain open.
